locators.section: Opening description; About the catchment; catchment waterways and land-use map; location inset

sources.direct_quote: Downstream of the site, the river discharges into Oyster Harbour.
own_factual_extraction: The report identifies Kalgan River at Stevens Farm, site 602004, north of South Coast Highway. The catchment map and inset depict its drainage within the larger Oyster Harbour catchment.
The upper catchment includes part of Stirling Range National Park; Porongurup National Park is nearer its centre. The waterways are not individually named in this map.
limits: A catchment title does not name every tributary. The map supports broad course comparison, not exact part-to-name assignments or a surveyed mouth boundary.

locators.paragraph_locator: The two largest rivers are the King and Kalgan Rivers.

own_factual_extraction: DWER describes Kalgan as entering northeastern Oyster Harbour and its final nine kilometres as tidal. King River separately enters the northwestern harbour.
Young River, Napier Creek, Boonawarrup Creek, Stony Creek and Gaalgegup Creek are listed as Kalgan tributaries, rather than interchangeable Kalgan names.
limits: Ordinary official usage is not proof of a formal current naming register. The text supplies no selected source-reach crosswalk or coordinate-resolved tidal or name boundary.
